name: Real Estate Deal Deadline Tracker: ClickUp

parameters.content:
## 1. Check the request
The CRM posts deals to two webhooks. A shared secret header is required, and the body is checked before ClickUp is touched. Bad requests get a clear 401 or 400.

## 2. Find the deal and plan
ClickUp is the record. The deal task and its subtasks carry a Deal ID field, so a repeated webhook finds them instead of making copies. Deadlines are worked out here.

## 3. Write to ClickUp, one call at a time
Creates the deal task, then creates or moves each milestone subtask. One call per loop pass, so a retry only repeats the call that failed.

## 4. Log and answer
Amendments get a comment on the deal task that says what moved. The sender gets a JSON summary, and any failure raises an alert through the error workflow.

parameters.errorMessage: Deal webhook rejected: the X-Webhook-Secret header is missing or wrong (or WEBHOOK_SECRET is not set). If real deals land here, check the secret in your CRM.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ ok: false, deal_id: $json.dealId || null, errors: $json.errors }) }}
={{ JSON.stringify({ ok: false, deal_id: $('Validate Deal').first().json.dealId, error: 'ClickUp did not answer. Nothing was changed. Please retry later.' }) }}

parameters.errorMessage: ={{ 'Could not look up deal ' + $('Validate Deal').first().json.dealId + ' in ClickUp after 3 tries: ' + ($json.error?.message || 'unknown error') + '. Nothing was changed; the sender got a 502 and can retry.' }}

parameters.content:
## 5. Daily digest
Every morning, and on demand through Run Now, the settings are checked and ClickUp is asked for open milestones that are overdue or due within DIGEST_DAYS. They are grouped by person and by deal.

## 6. Send one message at a time
One Slack message and one email per person. A digest that already went out today with the same content is skipped, so running it twice sends nothing twice.

parameters.errorMessage: Digest Run Now rejected: the X-Webhook-Secret header is missing or wrong (or WEBHOOK_SECRET is not set).

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ ok: false, error: 'ClickUp did not answer, so no digest was sent. Please retry later.' }) }}

parameters.errorMessage: ={{ 'Deal digest stopped. ClickUp did not answer after 3 tries (' + ($json.error?.message || 'unknown error') + '). Nothing was sent.' }}
